topic: 教育与已发生的变化 · Independent new scenario: changes in adult education access
grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.

title: A New Start at the Community Learning Centre
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，完成8个阅读理解题。注意：本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。先读题，再读文章。答案必须来自文章。
passage:
A.  
Mia is 42 years old. She works in a small shop. Last year, she wanted to learn English. She went to the community learning centre near her home. The centre has evening classes for adults. Mia joined a class in September. She has studied there for eight months. She has already finished two books. She has not taken a test yet.

B.  
The centre has changed a lot since 2020. In the past, only young people came to the centre. Now, many older adults come too. The centre has opened a new computer room. It has also started free weekend classes. Mia's teacher, Mr. Chen, has worked at the centre since 2015. He says, "Adult learners are very busy. They have families and jobs. But they are also very serious."

C.  
Mia has made new friends in her class. Her friend, Tom, is 55. He has worked in a factory for thirty years. He has just started learning English. He has not missed a class yet. Mia and Tom have already planned to take a test next year. They have not decided which test yet. Mia says, "I have never felt too old to learn."

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for 与一般过去时的区别
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或从过去开始持续到现在的动作/状态。结构：have/has + 过去分词。already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还（没）”或“已经”；since 后接时间点，表示“自从”；for 后接时间段，表示“持续了多久”。一般过去时只表示过去发生的动作，与现在无关。例如：She has studied there for eight months.（现在完成时，强调持续到现在） vs. She studied there last year.（一般过去时，只说明过去）。
grammar.example: She has studied there for eight months.

questions.explanation: already 常用于现在完成时肯定句，主语 I 用 have + 过去分词 finished。
questions.evidence: She has already finished two books.

questions.prompt: She ______ to the new computer room yet.
questions.explanation: yet 用于否定句，现在完成时结构 has not + 过去分词 been。
questions.evidence: He has not missed a class yet.

questions.explanation: since + 时间点，表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时，主语 They 用 have lived。
questions.evidence: Mr. Chen, has worked at the centre since 2015.

questions.explanation: for + 时间段，表示持续了多久，用现在完成时，主语 He 用 has studied。
questions.evidence: She has studied there for eight months.

questions.prompt: We ______ a new teacher last week.
questions.explanation: last week 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时 met。
questions.evidence: Mia joined a class in September.

questions.prompt: ______ you ever ______ to a weekend class?
questions.explanation: ever 常用于现在完成时疑问句，主语 you 用 Have you ever been...?
questions.evidence: He has not missed a class yet.

questions.prompt: She ______ her keys, so she cannot open the door.
questions.explanation: 动作对现在造成影响（不能开门），用现在完成时 has lost。
questions.evidence: She has already finished two books.

questions.explanation: yesterday 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时 watched。
questions.evidence: Mia joined a class in September.
